claim.text: A project crawl is constrained to one origin, obeys applicable robots rules across queue entries and redirects, records URL-scoped observations/findings, respects page/time/request budgets, and surfaces persisted coverage limits; the captured PostgreSQL tests use the same disposable local database whose migration state the gate checks.

payload.challenge: The exact capture stops before its migration query or any product test. stdout contains only GATE_START; stderr says psql could not connect to /tmp/winseo-pgsocket/.s.PGSQL.55432: Operation not permitted (exit 2). This is an environment access failure, so the run neither supports nor disproves the combined crawl and same-disposable-DB claim. A capture after approved socket access is needed to evaluate it.
